offense_title_full: Purposely or Knowingly Makes Physical Contact of an Insulting or Provoking Nature with the Sports Official
offense_title_short: Purposely/Knowingly Makes Physical Contact of Insulting/Provoking Nature
offense_display_full: Assault Upon Sports Official - Purposely or Knowingly Makes Physical Contact of an Insulting or Provoking Nature with the Sports Official
offense_display_short: Assault - Sports Official - Purposely/Knowingly Makes Physical Contact of Insulting/Provoking Nature
description: A person commits the offense of assault upon a sports official if, while a sports official is acting as an official at an athletic contest in any sport at any level of amateur or professional competition, the person purposely or knowingly makes physical contact of an insulting or provoking nature with the sports official.
